content:
Maya S: FYI — submitting intake for Saffron-14B (14B dense) to be evaluated for hosted catalog. Need quant experiments, basic benchmarks, and an announcement plan.

Linus T: Thanks — quick checklist request: 1) model artifacts + eval harness 2) FP16 and 4-bit quant candidates 3) latency/cost baseline vs current 13B/70B entries 4) QA regressions on our regression set.

Maya S: Attached artifacts link: https://gcs.redwood/saffron-14b/v1/model.tar.gz (proto). Eval harness: repo: github.com/redwood/saffron-evals.

Zehra K: I'll run the quant sweep tomorrow. Initial smoke with 4-bit PTQ (GPTQ) looks promising on a quick run:
```
variant: saffron-4bit-gptq
throughput: 210 tok/s (p100)
latency (p95): 120ms
quality delta vs fp16 (truthset): -0.8% accuracy
embedding cosine (50k sample): 0.981
```

Sam D: Can you also capture sampling configs you used? we need deterministic seeds and temperature used in the eval harness. Add the inference CLI command please.

Zehra K: Sure — command I ran: 
```bash
redwood infer --model saffron-14b --variant saffron-4bit-gptq --temp 0.0 --seed 42 --batch 8 --max-tokens 256
```
Configs: top_p=0.95, temp=0.0, stop_tokens=["\n\n"]

Sofia P: Question for PMs/comms — what's the primary angle? cost-optimized mid-size model, or new capability (better code + reasoning)? We should pick messaging for the release blurb.

Maya S: Position as "cost-efficient general purpose 14B with improved embedding quality". Benchmarks show cheaper than our 13B host per-token cost at similar latency.

Linus T: On catalog metadata — include fields: model_id, family, params, default_variant, quant_variants, recommended_batch_size, latency_p95_ms, tokens_per_sec, known_regressions. Example entry to copy:
```json
{"model_id":"saffron-14b","family":"saffron","params":"14B","default_variant":"fp16","quant_variants":["saffron-4bit-gptq"],"recommended_batch_size":"8","latency_p95_ms":"120","tokens_per_sec":"210","known_regressions":"none at threshold 1%"}
```

Zehra K: One caveat — on our LL-retrieval adversarial set we see a 1.7% hit on factual recall vs fp16 for the 4-bit PTQ. Filing a ticket: RG-5049.

Maya S: Add rollout policy: canary to 5% hosted traffic for 48h, auto-metric rollback if quality drop >1.5% on regression set or latency p95 increases >25%.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: saffron-14b/canary@5% (owner: Linus T) — runbook linked: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/saffron-canary

Sam D: Draft announcement (short):
"Saffron-14B: a cost-efficient 14B model now available in the catalog. 4-bit GPTQ variants recommended for low-cost workloads; see docs for benchmarks and rollout notes.

Callouts: embeddings quality improved vs our 13B baseline. Known issue: minor factual recall regression on adversarial set (ticket RG-5049)."

Sofia P: I'll loop in marketing for a light blog + product notice. @Sam D can you prep the release snippet and a one-pager by EOD Friday?

Sam D: Yep — will draft and post in #announcements once ops confirms canary pass.

Linus T: Action items: ZK run full quant sweep (owner: Zehra) by 48h, Linus will run perf matrix on dedicated cluster (owner: Linus), Maya to author catalog entry + docs (owner: Maya), Sam to draft announcement (owner: Sam).

Maya S: Sounds good — tagging participants. Will update thread with catalog PR link once ready. :white_check_mark:
